title: Paul's use of the poet's line about Cretans
english: The poet who said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons,” was attacking them for wrongly pointing to a tomb of Zeus that does not exist. Paul used that same line, but so that he would not be thought to agree with the poet and testify to the immortality of the so-called Zeus, he added: “This testimony is true” (Titus 1:13). Paul means: That poet lied when he spoke in defense of Zeus, but Paul speaks the truth when he says that Cretans are always liars and idle gluttons. This testimony is true, not that one.
